releaseNotes.en:
## 1.6.10 Auto Updates 🔄

- Fixed errors when a module depends on updating YOLO Core.
- Improved the Core and module update logic, and introduced an auto-update option. (#611)
- Improved the context compaction implementation, adding a stronger system-level compaction mechanism while keeping the model's ability to compact on its own.
- Fixed knowledge bases that no longer exist still counting toward "needs attention", and the bottom bar permanently showing "waiting to retry". (#612)
- Reduced CPU usage during streaming output to improve performance.
- Simplified the settings and UI of the Agent tools/skills pages, and added search to them. (#599)
releaseNotes.zh:
## 1.6.10 自动更新 🔄

- 修复模块依赖更新 YOLO Core 时的报错问题
- 优化 core 和模块的更新逻辑，引入自动更新选项。（#611）
- 优化上下文压缩实现，引入更强制的系统级的上下文压缩机制，同时保留模型自主压缩的能力
- 修复已不存在的知识库仍被计入「需要关注」、底栏一直显示等待重试的问题。（#612）
- 优化流式输出的 CPU 占用，改善性能表现
- 精简 Agent 工具/技能页设置项与 UI；为 Agent 的工具/技能页增加搜索机制。（#599）

en.name: Learning mode

zh.name: 学习模式
zh.description: 通过学习计划、间隔重复与复习，把笔记转化为能够长期掌握的知识。

it.name: Modalità di apprendimento
it.description: Trasforma le note in conoscenze durature con piani di studio guidati, ripetizione dilazionata e ripasso.

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.1.4 Cross-Device Learning Data Sync 🔄

- Learning data (spaced-repetition state and Anki import journals) now lives in the visible `data/` directory inside your vault, so sync tools like Obsidian Sync can replicate your review progress across devices. Existing data is migrated automatically.
- Requires YOLO Core 1.6.5 or later, which performs the storage migration before the module activates.
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.1.4 学习数据跨设备同步 🔄

- 学习数据（间隔重复状态与 Anki 导入日志）迁至 vault 内可见的 `data/` 目录，Obsidian Sync 等同步工具可跨设备同步复习进度；存量数据自动迁移。
- 需要 YOLO Core 1.6.5 及以上版本（Core 会在模块激活前完成存储迁移）。

en.name: YOLO Whiteboard
en.description: An infinite canvas for spatial thinking: place note, text, and PDF cards, connect them, and read/annotate PDFs alongside your notes.

zh.name: YOLO 白板
zh.description: 用于空间化思考的无限画布：摆放笔记、便签与 PDF 卡片，建立连线，并在笔记旁阅读与标注 PDF。

it.name: Lavagna YOLO
it.description: Una tela infinita per il pensiero spaziale: disponi schede di note, testo e PDF, collegale tra loro e leggi/annota i PDF accanto alle tue note.

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.0.5 Minimap & Smoother Zooming 🗺️

- Added a minimap, so you can view and jump across the whole whiteboard at any time while zoomed in to read.
- Raised the whiteboard's maximum zoom to 500%.
- Improved trackpad zoom speed.
- Improved the smoothness of PDF interactions.
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.0.5 小地图与更顺手的缩放 🗺️

- 新增小地图，放大阅读时可随时查看并跳转画板全局。
- 白板最大缩放提高到 500%。
- 优化触控板的缩放速度。
- 优化 PDF 的交互流畅度。
